notes:
The package serves one environment, the card's first entry symbol: QuadrotorStabilizeAttitude-MotorCommands-v0 / gym_quadrotor.envs:CopterStabilizeAttitudeEnv (gym_quadrotor/envs/attitude_env.py:11, registered at gym_quadrotor/__init__.py:19-23). The other card entry symbols are not covered: CopterStabilizeAttitude2DEnv (gym_quadrotor/envs/minimal.py:17), CopterStabilizeAttitude2DMarkovianEnv (gym_quadrotor/envs/minimal.py:73) and the Angular registration (card line gym_quadrotor/__init__.py:25, confidence recon), whose entry point is a factory function (gym_quadrotor/envs/attitude_env.py:58-60), not a class; serving another environment needs a package with its own env_id, native and fake. The fake backend is a pure Python reimplementation of the rotational equations of gym_quadrotor/dynamics/dynamics.py and copter.py, including the registration's 500-step truncation, because the gate has no gym or numpy and package code never imports the clone. The upstream simulator path (backend sim: gym.make after gym_quadrotor registers the id) was not run, and the fake was not compared with the upstream environment; the fidelity gaps list the known differences. The fake returns the full six-value state array; no output was truncated. There is no hardware backend, no hardware was used, and no human reviewed or tested anything. Accepted warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed selects the next reset and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT warnings for the bridge-derived inputs (ticks, seed in reset, seed in seed, action.values); there were no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. The four motor commands are bounded by the upstream action space Box(0,1,(4,)) (gym_quadrotor/envs/base.py:18), which the bridge derives from the fake's action space; the driver declares no Limit and no operator-required bound, so there is no site-limits overlay. Every Fact cites upstream_code in the clone; numbers in fake.py are test data of the fake and are not Facts, Limits or references.
